message.content:
I’m afraid I don’t have a built‑in “fetch” function that pulls live holiday calendars from an external service, so I can’t retrieve a database‑driven list for you. However, I can give you a quick rundown of the major Canadian public holidays that usually create long weekends in 2023, along with the dates they fell on and a note about provincial variations. If you need a more detailed, province‑specific calendar, you’ll likely have to pull that from a dedicated holiday API or a government source.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Typical Long Weekend? | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Yes – Observed Monday, Jan 2 | Federal & most provinces observe the following Monday. |
| **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Monday) | Yes – Observed Monday | Observed in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, and Yukon. |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | Yes – Friday + Saturday | Observed nationwide; creates a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | Yes – Observed Monday | Federal & most provinces observe the preceding Monday. |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) | No – Observed Monday, Jul 3 | Observed Monday, Jul 3 in most provinces. |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | Yes – Observed Monday | Federal & all provinces observe the following Monday. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | Yes – Observed Monday | Federal & all provinces observe the following Monday. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Wednesday) | No – Observed Monday, Nov 13 | Observed Monday, Nov 13 in most provinces. |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Monday) | Yes – Observed Monday | Federal & all provinces observe the following Monday. |

### How to Use This List

1. **Identify Your Province** – Some holidays (e.g., Family Day, Remembrance Day) are province‑specific. Check your local government website for exact observances.
2. **Add Observed Dates** – If a holiday falls on a weekend, many provinces shift the observance to the following Monday. Adjust accordingly.
3. **Integrate Into Your App** – Store these dates in your database or calendar module. You can flag them as “long weekend” events for UI display.

If you need a programmatic way to pull the exact dates for each province, you could use a holiday API such as [Calendarific](https://calendarific.com/) or the Canadian government’s open data portal. Once you have the raw data, you can parse it and mark the long weekends in your application logic.

Let me know if you’d like help writing code to process that data or if you need a more granular breakdown for a specific province!
